candidates.rule: Pin each feature flag default in a test before the screen reads it.
candidates.check: A test names the flag and its default.

candidates.rule: Always log the request ID on every error path of each handler.
candidates.check: Each catch block of each handler logs the request ID.

candidates.rule: Never render a card without a theme provider.
candidates.check: A test renders each card inside a theme provider.

candidates.rule: Dismiss the keyboard from every native text field with the Done key and with a tap outside.
candidates.check: A UI test taps outside the field and expects no focus.

candidates.rule: Check each text field with the keyboard open, on a device or a simulator, and on a small screen.
candidates.check: The device check pack lists each new text field and one small device.

candidates.rule: Anchor a score panel to the bottom of the screen above the safe area.
candidates.check: A capture shows the panel above the home indicator.

candidates.rule: Link each architecture decision record from the design log.
candidates.check: The doc linter finds each record in the design log.
